reason: Fruit concentrate means sugar, and the pitch never says how many grams per can, so as someone who only drinks Zero versions I'm not ordering it blind. And if I want a mate, YEAHRBA is already in my Rohlík basket for less.
objection: "Nothing else" and "natural" tell me nothing. Every brand says that now. I want the sugar per can in grams, and 55 CZK for 330 ml is more than the mate I already buy.
would_change_my_mind: A clear label showing close to zero sugar (under about 2 g per can), and finding it in the fridge at my lunch bistro so I could try one without ordering a delivery.
